name: rest-api
description: 12 icon untuk topic REST API (analogi restoran, revisi-02) — 2 batch. Batch-1: objek inti (gedung restoran, kunci, formulir, papan nama, pelanggan). Batch-2: method badge (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) + stempel status 200/201, reuse 100% dari revisi-01 (analogi kantor pos), tidak berubah karena generic lintas-analogi. Warna dicocokkan ke pemakaian aktual di Animation.jsx (lihat revisi/2026-09-11-1241-revisi-02.md § Audit Icon). Semua AI-generate via ChatGPT.

batches.prompt:
Generate a 2x4 grid of 8 minimalist flat-design icons on transparent background (PNG). Icons are numbered top-left to bottom-right, left-to-right, row by row:

1. Small restaurant building icon, restaurant-style roof (not post-office style), windows with curtains, a small menu board near the entrance, simple flat outline, orange color (#FB923C)
2. Simple standalone padlock/key icon (not attached to an envelope), conveying a locked/restricted resource, amber/yellow color (#FBBF24)
3. Paper form icon with several neat horizontal label:value rows (like structured order-form fields), purple color (#A78BFA)
4. Starburst/jagged-edge badge shape with a signpost feel, blank surface for a short label, purple color (#A78BFA)
5. Simple cartoon customer character, circular head + simple body, flat minimalist style consistent with the other icons, blue color (#38BDF8)
6. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]
7. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]
8. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist, consistent visual weight across all icons
- Use ONLY the exact color specified per icon, no gradients
- Each icon same overall size, clearly distinct silhouette
- High contrast against transparent background
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 2 rows x 4 columns
- Recommended total size: 2048x1024 pixels (512x512 per icon)
